q: 1863 में मद्रास के निकट पल्लवरम से प्रथम पुरापाषाणकालीन हस्त-कुठार (hand-axe) खोजने के लिए किसे "भारतीय प्रागैतिहास का जनक" कहा जाता है?
e: British geologist Robert Bruce Foote discovered the first Palaeolithic stone hand-axe at Pallavaram (Tamil Nadu) in 1863 and is called the Father of Indian Prehistory. (रॉबर्ट ब्रूस फुट ने 1863 में पल्लवरम से प्रथम हस्त-कुठार खोजा।) Exam Boosters: (1) Alexander Cunningham is called the "Father of Indian Archaeology" (first Director-General of ASI, 1861). (2) Sir John Marshall oversaw the excavations of Harappa (1921) and Mohenjo-daro (1922).
qe: Who is regarded as the "Father of Indian Prehistory" for discovering the first Palaeolithic hand-axe at Pallavaram near Madras in 1863?

q: मध्य प्रदेश का कौन-सा यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल पुरापाषाण और मध्यपाषाण काल के प्रागैतिहासिक शैलाश्रयों व गुफा चित्रों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Bhimbetka (Raisen district, MP), discovered by Dr. V. S. Wakankar in 1957–58, contains over 500 rock shelters depicting hunting, dancing, and animal scenes from Palaeolithic to historic periods (UNESCO site, 2003). Exam Boosters: (1) Major colours used in Bhimbetka paintings are red ochre (geru) and white. (2) Adamgarh (MP) and Bagor (Rajasthan) are other key Mesolithic sites.
qe: Which UNESCO World Heritage Site in Madhya Pradesh is renowned for its prehistoric rock shelters and cave paintings spanning the Palaeolithic and Mesolithic periods?

q: "सूक्ष्मपाषाण उपकरण" (Microliths) कहलाने वाले छोटे और परिष्कृत पाषाण औजार किस प्रागैतिहासिक काल की मुख्य विशेषता हैं?
e: Microliths (tiny geometric/non-geometric blades, crescents, triangles, trapezes—often hafted onto bone/wood) define the Mesolithic Age (~10,000–4,000 BCE). Exam Boosters: (1) Lower Palaeolithic: Core tools (hand-axes, cleavers, choppers). (2) Middle Palaeolithic: Flake tools (scrapers, points, borers; called "Nevasan culture" by H. D. Sankalia). (3) Upper Palaeolithic: Blades and burins + bone tools.
qe: Tiny, finely shaped stone tools known as "Microliths" (सूक्ष्मपाषाण उपकरण) are the hallmark of which prehistoric age?

q: जम्मू-कश्मीर के किस नवपाषाणकालीन स्थल से पुरातत्वविदों को गर्तावास (pit-dwellings) तथा मानव मालिक के साथ कुत्ते को दफनाने के अनूठे साक्ष्य मिले हैं?
e: Burzahom ("Place of Birch", near Srinagar, J&K; excavated by de Terra & Paterson, 1935) is famous for circular/oval pit-dwellings, bone tools, and dog burials alongside human skeletons. Exam Boosters: (1) Gufkral ("Potter's Cave", J&K) also yielded pit-dwellings and early agriculture evidence. (2) Chirand (Saran district, Bihar) is renowned for abundant antler/bone tools.
qe: At which Neolithic site in Jammu & Kashmir have archaeologists excavated pit-dwellings (गर्तावास) and the unique practice of burying dogs along with their human masters?

q:
सूची-I (प्रागैतिहासिक स्थल) को सूची-II (प्रमुख पुरातात्विक साक्ष्य) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. मेहरगढ़ — (a) बेलन घाटी में धान की खेती के प्राचीनतम साक्ष्य
2. कोल्डिहवा — (b) राजस्थान में पशुपालन के प्राचीनतम साक्ष्य
3. बागोर — (c) बलूचिस्तान में गेहूँ-जौ की कृषि व स्थायी बस्ती के प्रारंभिक साक्ष्य
4. चिरांद — (d) बिहार में प्रचुर नवपाषाणकालीन अस्थि उपकरण
e: Mehrgarh (Bolan Pass, Baluchistan, c. 7000 BCE): earliest wheat/barley & cotton (1-c); Koldihwa (Prayagraj, UP): early rice husks (2-a); Bagor (Bhilwara, Rajasthan, Kothari river): earliest Mesolithic animal domestication along with Adamgarh (3-b); Chirand (Bihar): bone tools (4-d). Exam Boosters: (1) Lahuradewa (Sant Kabir Nagar, UP) has yielded even older rice cultivation evidence (~8000–7000 BCE).
qe:
Match List-I (Prehistoric Site) with List-II (Key Archaeological Evidence):
1. Mehrgarh (मेहरगढ़) — (a) Earliest evidence of rice cultivation in Belan Valley
2. Koldihwa (कोल्डिहवा) — (b) Earliest evidence of animal domestication in Rajasthan
3. Bagor (बागोर) — (c) Earliest wheat-barley farming & settled village in Baluchistan
4. Chirand (चिरांद) — (d) Abundant Neolithic bone & antler tools in Bihar

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रतापगढ़ जिले के किस मध्यपाषाणकालीन स्थल से एक ही कब्र में तीन मानव कंकालों (त्रियुग्म शवाधान) तथा हड्डी के आभूषणों के साक्ष्य मिले हैं?
e: Damdama (Pratapgarh, UP) yielded 41 human graves, including 5 double burials and 1 triple burial (three skeletons in one grave), plus bone ornaments. Exam Boosters: (1) Mahadaha (Pratapgarh) yielded couple burials and bone/horn implements. (2) Sarai Nahar Rai (Pratapgarh) yielded a skeleton with a microlith embedded in its rib (earliest evidence of human conflict). (3) Chopani Mando (Belan Valley, Prayagraj) yielded early handmade pottery.
qe: Which Mesolithic site in Pratapgarh district of Uttar Pradesh has yielded evidence of three human skeletons buried together in a single grave (triple burial) and bone ornaments?

q: मौसमी पशुपालन शिविरों से संबद्ध "राख के टीले" (Ash mounds) भारत के किस क्षेत्र की नवपाषाण संस्कृति की विशिष्ट पहचान हैं?
e: Ash mounds formed by periodic burning of accumulated cow-dung are characteristic of South Indian Neolithic sites such as Piklihal, Utnur, Sangankallu, Kodekal, and Budihal (Karnataka & Andhra Pradesh). Exam Boosters: (1) South Indian Neolithic people cultivated ragi (millet) and horse gram (kulthi).
qe: Ash mounds (राख के टीले) associated with seasonal cattle-herding camps are a distinctive feature of the Neolithic culture of which region of India?

q: भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में प्रथम जीवाश्म मानव कपाल ("नर्मदा मानव") 1982 में किस स्थल से खोजा गया था?
e: Geologist Arun Sonakia discovered the Narmada Man fossil cranium at Hathnora (Sehore district, Narmada Valley, MP) in December 1982. Exam Boosters: (1) Patne (Maharashtra) yielded Upper Palaeolithic ostrich eggshell beads. (2) Attirampakkam (Tamil Nadu) is one of India's oldest Lower Palaeolithic Acheulian sites.
qe: The first fossilized human skull (Homo erectus / archaic Homo sapiens) in the Indian subcontinent—known as "Narmada Man"—was discovered in 1982 at which site?

q: महाराष्ट्र की कौन-सी ताम्रपाषाण संस्कृति लाल सतह पर काले चित्रित टोंटीदार मृदभांडों, इनामगाँव व दैमाबाद जैसी बड़ी बस्तियों तथा घरों के फर्श के नीचे उत्तर-दक्षिण दिशा में शवाधान के लिए जानी जाती है?
e: The Jorwe Culture (c. 1400–700 BCE, Maharashtra; type site Jorwe, major sites Daimabad, Inamgaon, Nevasa) featured fine red pottery with black geometric designs, bronze chariot/elephant/rhino/buffalo figures from Daimabad, and North–South urn/pit burials beneath house floors. Exam Boosters: (1) Ahar (Rajasthan) was anciently called "Tambavati" (copper-rich). (2) Navdatoli (MP, excavated by H. D. Sankalia) is the largest Malwa culture site.
qe: Which Chalcolithic culture of Maharashtra is known for its black-on-red spouted pottery, large settled villages like Inamgaon and Daimabad, and burying the dead under house floors in North–South orientation?

q:
भारत में नवपाषाण क्रांति के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: नवपाषाण काल में कृषि व पशुपालन, पॉलिशदार पाषाण कुल्हाड़ियाँ (celts), चाक निर्मित मृदभांड और स्थायी ग्राम्य जीवन का उदय हुआ।
कथन II: भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में नवपाषाण काल सभी क्षेत्रों में एक साथ लगभग 7000 ई.पू. में प्रारंभ हुआ।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो I और न ही II
e: Statement I is correct (term "Neolithic Revolution" coined by V. Gordon Childe). Statement II is incorrect because the Neolithic age began at widely varying dates regionally—c. 7000 BCE in Mehrgarh (NW), c. 2500 BCE in Kashmir & South India, and c. 2000–1500 BCE in Eastern India.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Neolithic Revolution in India:
Statement I: Domestication of plants and animals, polished stone axes (celts), wheel-made pottery, and sedentary village life emerged during the Neolithic period.
Statement II: In the Indian subcontinent, the Neolithic period began uniformly across all regions around 7000 BCE.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: गंगा-यमुना दोआब की गैरिक मृदभांड (OCP) संस्कृति किस पुरातात्विक क्षितिज से घनिष्ठ रूप से संबद्ध है?
e: OCP (identified by B. B. Lal at Hastinapura, 1951) is widely linked to the Gangetic Copper Hoard Culture (harpoons, anthropomorphic figures, antennae swords found at Gungeria, Bisauli, Rajpur Parsu). Exam Boosters: (1) PGW (c. 1100–600 BCE) is associated with Later Vedic/Mahabharata sites. (2) NBPW (c. 600–200 BCE) is associated with Second Urbanization and Mauryan Empire.
qe: The Ochre Coloured Pottery (OCP — गैरिक मृदभांड) culture of the Ganga-Yamuna Doab is closely associated with which archaeological horizon?

q: बेलन नदी घाटी में निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र ने निम्न पुरापाषाण, मध्य पुरापाषाण, उच्च पुरापाषाण, मध्यपाषाण से लेकर नवपाषाण तक का निरंतर सांस्कृतिक अनुक्रम प्रदान किया है?
e: Excavated by Prof. G. R. Sharma (University of Allahabad), the Belan Valley (UP) displays a continuous stratigraphic sequence across all three Palaeolithic phases, Mesolithic (Chopani Mando), and Neolithic (Koldihwa, Mahagara). Exam Boosters: (1) A bone figurine of a Mother Goddess (Upper Palaeolithic) was discovered at Lohanda Nala in the Belan Valley.
qe: Which of the following prehistoric sites has yielded an unbroken cultural sequence from Lower Palaeolithic, Middle Palaeolithic, Upper Palaeolithic, Mesolithic to Neolithic in the Belan River Valley?

q: कौन-सा हड़प्पा स्थल अपने अनूठे ज्वारीय गोदीबाड़ा (dockyard), मनका बनाने के कारखाने तथा धान की भूसी के साक्ष्यों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Lothal (on the Bhogava river, Gujarat; excavated by S. R. Rao, 1954) featured a brick-lined tidal dockyard, Persian Gulf seal, double burials, and rice husk evidence. Exam Boosters: (1) Chanhudaro (Sindh, no citadel) also had a famous bead-making workshop. (2) Surkotada (Gujarat) yielded actual skeletal remains of a horse.
qe: Which Harappan site is famous for its unique tidal dockyard (गोदीबाड़ा), bead-making factory, and evidence of rice husk?

q: 'लुप्त मोम' (lost-wax) तकनीक से निर्मित प्रसिद्ध "नर्तकी की कांस्य मूर्ति" किस हड़प्पा स्थल से प्राप्त हुई थी?
e: The 10.5 cm bronze Dancing Girl, the steatite Bearded Priest-King, the Pashupati Seal, and the Great Bath were all excavated from Mohenjo-daro (Larkana, Sindh). Exam Boosters: (1) Rakhigarhi (Haryana) is the largest Harappan site in India. (2) Dholavira (Kachchh, Gujarat) was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021.
qe: The famous bronze statue of the "Dancing Girl" (नर्तकी की कांस्य मूर्ति) crafted via the lost-wax (cire perdue) technique was excavated from:

q: निम्नलिखित चार वेदों में से किसके तृतीय मंडल में प्रसिद्ध "गायत्री मंत्र" (सविता देवता को समर्पित) संकलित है?
e: The Gayatri Mantra (composed by Sage Vishwamitra) appears in the 3rd Mandala of the Rigveda (10 Mandalas, 1,028 Suktas). Exam Boosters: (1) 9th Mandala of Rigveda is dedicated exclusively to Soma. (2) 10th Mandala contains the Purusha Sukta (first mention of the four Varnas) and Nasadiya Sukta (hymn of creation).
qe: Which of the following four Vedas contains the famous "Gayatri Mantra" (addressed to Savitr) in its Third Mandala?

q: भारत का राष्ट्रीय आदर्श वाक्य "सत्यमेव जयते" किस उपनिषद से लिया गया है?
e: "Satyameva Jayate" originates from the Mundaka Upanishad (attached to Atharvaveda). Exam Boosters: (1) Katha Upanishad: Yama–Nachiketa dialogue on soul and death. (2) Brihadaranyaka Upanishad: Yajnavalkya–Gargi dialogue ("Aham Brahmasmi", "Tamaso Ma Jyotirgamaya"). (3) Jabala Upanishad: First clear mention of all four Ashramas (Brahmacharya, Grihastha, Vanaprastha, Sanyasa).
qe: The national motto of India, "Satyameva Jayate" (सत्यमेव जयते), is taken from which Upanishad?

q: ऋग्वैदिक काल में सबसे प्रमुख देवता कौन थे, जिनकी स्तुति में लगभग 250 सूक्त हैं और जिन्हें "पुरंदर" (किले तोड़ने वाला) कहा गया है?
e: Indra (God of thunder/rain and warlord) is the most celebrated Rigvedic god (250 hymns), followed by Agni (200 hymns, mediator between gods and humans) and Varuna (upholder of cosmic moral order 'Rta'). Exam Boosters: (1) In the Later Vedic period, Prajapati (creator), Vishnu, and Rudra replaced Indra and Agni in prominence.
qe: In the Rigvedic Age, which deity was the most prominent, invoked in nearly 250 hymns and called "Purandara" (Destroyer of Forts)?

q: कौन-सा हड़प्पा स्थल सामान्य दो भागों के बजाय अनूठे रूप से तीन भागों (दुर्ग, मध्य नगर व निचला नगर) में विभाजित था तथा उत्कृष्ट जल-प्रबंधन व स्टेडियम के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Dholavira (excavated by J. P. Joshi & R. S. Bisht on Khadir Bet island, Gujarat) had a three-tier town plan, massive stone-lined water reservoirs, and a 10-sign Harappan "signboard".
qe: Which Harappan site is uniquely divided into THREE parts (Citadel, Middle Town, and Lower Town) instead of the usual two, and had a remarkable stadium and water-harvesting reservoirs?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा हड़प्पा स्थल उस नदी के साथ सही सुमेलित नहीं है जिसके तट पर वह स्थित है?
e: Alamgirpur (Meerut, UP—easternmost site of IVC) is located on the bank of the Hindon River (a tributary of Yamuna), NOT directly on the Yamuna. Exam Boosters: (1) Extreme boundaries of IVC: North—Manda (Chenab, J&K); South—Daimabad (Pravara, Maharashtra); East—Alamgirpur (Hindon, UP); West—Sutkagendor (Dasht, Baluchistan).
qe: Which of the following Harappan sites is NOT correctly matched with the river on whose bank it is located?

q: मेसोपोटामिया के कीलाक्षर अभिलेखों (अक्कड़ के सार्गोन) में सिंधु घाटी क्षेत्र के लिए किस नाम का प्रयोग किया गया है जिससे मेसोपोटामिया का व्यापार होता था?
e: Mesopotamian records referred to the Indus Valley as "Meluhha" (known for carnelian, lapis lazuli, ivory, cotton, and timber), while Dilmun was Bahrain and Magan was Oman/Makran coast (intermediate trading stations).
qe: In Mesopotamian cuneiform records (Sargon of Akkad), what name was used to refer to the Indus Valley region with which Mesopotamia traded?

q: अपठित सिंधु घाटी (हड़प्पा) लिपि में लेखन की किस शैली का प्रयोग किया गया था?
o: बौस्ट्रोफेडन — दाएँ से बाएँ, फिर बाएँ से दाएँ
e: The Harappan script is pictographic/logo-syllabic (~400–450 signs, fish sign most frequent) and written in Boustrophedon style—starting from right to left in the first line and continuing left to right in the second line.
qe: Which style of writing was used in the undeciphered Indus Valley (Harappan) script?

q: प्रसिद्ध "दशराज्ञ युद्ध", जिसमें भरत जन के राजा सुदास ने दस राजाओं के संघ को पराजित किया था, किस ऋग्वैदिक नदी के तट पर लड़ा गया था?
e: Mentioned in the 7th Mandala of the Rigveda, the Battle of Ten Kings was fought on the bank of River Parushni (modern Ravi). Exam Boosters: (1) Rigvedic river names: Vitasta (Jhelum), Asikni (Chenab), Parushni (Ravi), Vipasha (Beas), Shutudri (Sutlej), Kubha (Kabul), Sadaneera (Gandak).
qe: The famous "Battle of Ten Kings" (दशराज्ञ युद्ध), in which King Sudas of the Bharata tribe defeated a confederacy of ten kings, was fought on the bank of which Rigvedic river?

q: अथर्ववेद में किन दो वैदिक राजनीतिक संस्थाओं को "प्रजापति की दो पुत्रियाँ" कहा गया है?
e: In the Atharvaveda, Sabha (council of elders/elites) and Samiti (general folk assembly that elected the Rajan) are called the twin daughters of Prajapati. Exam Boosters: (1) Vidatha was the oldest Rigvedic assembly (for redistribution of booty and rituals) in which women also participated actively; it disappeared in the Later Vedic period.
qe: In the Atharvaveda, which two Rigvedic political assemblies were famously described as the "two daughters of Prajapati"?

q:
सूची-I (वेद) को सूची-II (संबंधित पुरोहित) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. ऋग्वेद — (a) अध्वर्यु
2. सामवेद — (b) होतृ
3. यजुर्वेद — (c) ब्रह्मा
4. अथर्ववेद — (d) उद्गातृ
e: Rigveda hymns were recited by Hotri (1-b); Samaveda melodies sung by Udgatri (2-d); Yajurveda sacrificial formulas performed by Adhvaryu (3-a); and Atharvaveda/overall ritual supervised by Brahma (4-c). Exam Boosters: (1) Rigveda, Samaveda, and Yajurveda together are called "Vedatrayi" (वेदत्रयी).
qe:
Match List-I (Vedic Samhita) with List-II (Associated Priest / Rtvij):
1. Rigveda (ऋग्वेद) — (a) Adhvaryu (अध्वर्यु)
2. Samaveda (सामवेद) — (b) Hotri (होतृ)
3. Yajurveda (यजुर्वेद) — (c) Brahma (ब्रह्मा)
4. Atharvaveda (अथर्ववेद) — (d) Udgatri (उद्गातृ)

q:
सूची-I (षड्दर्शन) को सूची-II (प्रवर्तक) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. सांख्य — (a) गौतम
2. योग — (b) कपिल
3. न्याय — (c) कणाद
4. वैशेषिक — (d) पतंजलि
e: Samkhya (oldest philosophy): Kapila (1-b); Yoga: Patanjali (2-d); Nyaya (logic): Akshapada Gautama (3-a); Vaisheshika (atomic theory): Kanada (4-c). Exam Boosters: (1) The other two Shad-Darshanas are Purva Mimamsa (Jaimini) and Uttara Mimamsa / Vedanta (Badarayana).
qe:
Match List-I (Shad-Darshana / Six Orthodox Schools of Indian Philosophy) with List-II (Propounder):
1. Samkhya (सांख्य) — (a) Gautama (गौतम)
2. Yoga (योग) — (b) Kapila (कपिल)
3. Nyaya (न्याय) — (c) Kanada (कणाद)
4. Vaisheshika (वैशेषिक) — (d) Patanjali (पतंजलि)

q: उत्तर वैदिक अर्थव्यवस्था में किस नई धातु—जिसे "श्याम अयस" या "कृष्ण अयस" कहा गया—ने गंगा के मैदानों में बड़े पैमाने पर वन-सफाई को बढ़ावा दिया?
e: Iron ("Shyama Ayas / Krishna Ayas", c. 1000 BCE; early iron evidence at Atranjikhera in Etah, UP) revolutionized agriculture and clearance of dense Gangetic forests, paving the way for territorial Janapadas. Exam Boosters: (1) In Rigveda, "Ayas" referred to copper/bronze; iron was unknown to Rigvedic and Harappan peoples.
qe: In the Later Vedic economy, which new metal—referred to as "Shyama Ayas" or "Krishna Ayas"—catalyzed large-scale forest clearing in the Gangetic plains?

q:
सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: हड़प्पा के बाट मुख्यतः चर्ट पत्थर के घनाकार होते थे और निचले मानों में द्विआधारी (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) तथा ऊपरी मानों में दशमलव प्रणाली का पालन करते थे।
कथन II: हड़प्पा की मुहरें मुख्यतः लोहे की बनी होती थीं और उन पर सर्वाधिक गाय का अंकन मिलता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो I और न ही II
e: Statement I is correct. Statement II is incorrect because Harappan seals were mostly made of steatite (सेलखड़ी), iron was unknown, and the most frequently depicted animal was the one-horned Unicorn (एकशृंगी वृषभ), NOT the cow (no seal depicts a cow or lion).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Indus Valley Civilization:
Statement I: Harappan weights were made mostly of chert in cubical shapes and followed a binary ratio in lower denominations (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) and decimal in higher denominations.
Statement II: Harappan seals were predominantly made of iron and depicted the cow as the most frequently engraved animal.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: मोहनजोदड़ो के बिखरे कंकालों और ऋग्वेद के "हरियूपिया" उल्लेख का हवाला देते हुए किस विद्वान ने सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के पतन हेतु "आर्य आक्रमण सिद्धांत" का प्रतिपादन किया?
e: Sir Mortimer Wheeler (and Stuart Piggott) proposed the Aryan Invasion Theory, later strongly refuted by G. F. Dales and modern archaeology which emphasize ecological shifts, drying of Ghaggar-Hakra (Saraswati), floods (Marshall/Mackay/S. R. Rao), and climate aridity.
qe: Which of the following scholars proposed the "Aryan Invasion Theory" for the decline of the Indus Valley Civilization, citing unburied skeletons at Mohenjo-daro and Rigvedic references to "Hariyupiya"?

q: एशिया माइनर (तुर्की) का बोगजकोई अभिलेख (लगभग 1400 ई.पू.), जिसमें हित्ती और मितन्नी के बीच संधि दर्ज है, ऐतिहासिक रूप से महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि इसमें किन चार वैदिक देवताओं का उल्लेख है?
e: The Boghazkoi inscription (discovered by Hugo Winckler, 1907) invokes four Rigvedic deities—Indra, Mitra, Varuna, and Nasatya (Ashvins)—as treaty witnesses, supporting the Indo-European/Central Asian linguistic link.
qe: The Boghazkoi Inscription (c. 1400 BCE, Asia Minor / Turkey), recording a treaty between the Hittites and Mitannis, is historically significant because it mentions which four Vedic gods?

q: उत्तर वैदिक काल में राजा विदेह माधव द्वारा सदानीरा (गंडक) नदी तक अग्नि ले जाने की कथा, जो पूर्वी भारत में आर्य विस्तार की प्रतीक है, किस ब्राह्मण ग्रंथ में वर्णित है?
e: The Shatapatha Brahmana (attached to Shukla Yajurveda; oldest and largest Brahmana) narrates the Videgha Madhava legend (with priest Gotama Rahugana), plus the Jalaplavan (Great Flood) story and agricultural rituals. Exam Boosters: (1) Aitareya Brahmana (Rigveda) mentions the origin of kingship and "Charaiveti-Charaiveti". (2) Gopatha Brahmana belongs to Atharvaveda.
qe: In the Later Vedic period, the story of King Videgha Madhava carrying sacred fire eastward up to the River Sadanira (Gandak), symbolizing Aryan expansion into eastern India, is narrated in which Brahmana text?

q: उत्तर वैदिक प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था में "भागदुघ" (Bhagadugha) नामक रत्निन (उच्च अधिकारी) का विशिष्ट कार्य क्या था?
e: In Later Vedic polity (12 Ratnins mentioned in Shatapatha Brahmana), Bhagadugha was the collector of royal share/taxes (भाग), whereas Sangrahitri was the Treasurer (कोषाध्यक्ष), Suta was the Charioteer, and Akshavapa was the superintendent of dicing/accounts.
qe: In the Later Vedic administrative system, what was the specific role of the Ratnin (high official) designated as "Bhagadugha" (भागदुघ)?

q: ऋग्वैदिक बनाम उत्तर वैदिक काल में स्त्रियों की स्थिति के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: लोपामुद्रा, घोषा, अपाला जैसी ऋग्वैदिक विदुषियों ने मंत्र रचे
ऋग्वैदिक समाज में विधवा पुनर्विवाह/नियोग प्रचलित था
मैत्रेयी व गार्गी ने उत्तर वैदिक काल में दार्शनिक शास्त्रार्थ में भाग लिया
उत्तर वैदिक काल में स्त्रियों को सभा व विदथ में पूर्ण भागीदारी बनी रही
e: In the Later Vedic period, women's status declined—they were barred from attending the Sabha (Maitrayani Samhita grouped women with dice and liquor), and Vidatha vanished. Thus Statement D is incorrect, while A, B, and C are historically accurate.
qe: Which of the following statements about women's status in the Rigvedic versus Later Vedic period is NOT correct?
oe: Rigvedic women like Lopamudra, Ghosha, and Apala composed Vedic hymns
Widow remarriage (Niyoga) was permitted in the Rigvedic society
Maitreyi and Gargi participated in philosophical debates in the Later Vedic period
Women retained full rights to attend the Sabha and Vidatha throughout the Later Vedic period

q: जैन धर्म के 23वें तीर्थंकर कौन थे (जन्म वाराणसी, प्रतीक चिह्न सर्प), जिन्होंने चार महाव्रतों (चातुर्याम) का उपदेश दिया?
e: Parshvanatha (son of King Ashvasena of Varanasi, attained Kaivalya on Sammed Shikhar / Parasnath Hill) was the 23rd Tirthankara; he taught Satya, Ahimsa, Asteya, and Aparigraha. Mahavira (24th Tirthankara, emblem Lion) added the 5th vow—Brahmacharya. Exam Boosters: (1) 1st Tirthankara: Rishabhadeva / Adinatha (emblem Bull; mentioned in Rigveda). (2) 22nd Tirthankara: Arishtanemi (emblem Conch).
qe: Who was the 23rd Tirthankara of Jainism (born in Varanasi, emblem Snake/Serpent), who taught four vows (Chaturayama)?

q: गौतम बुद्ध ने बोधगया में किस वृक्ष के नीचे और किस नदी के तट पर ज्ञान (संबोधि) प्राप्त किया था?
e: At age 35, Siddhartha Gautama attained Enlightenment under a Peepal (Bodhi) tree on the bank of River Niranjana (Phalgu) at Uruvela (Bodh Gaya). Exam Boosters: (1) Vardhamana Mahavira attained Kaivalya at age 42 under a Sal tree on the bank of River Rijupalika at Jrimbhikagrama.
qe: Under which tree and on the bank of which river did Gautama Buddha attain Enlightenment (निर्वाण / संबोधि) at Bodh Gaya?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा जैन धर्म के "त्रिरत्न" (Triratna) में सम्मिलित नहीं है?
e: The Triratna of Jainism are Samyak Darshana, Samyak Jnana, and Samyak Charitra. (In Buddhism, the Three Jewels / Triratna are Buddha, Dhamma, and Sangha.)
qe: Which of the following is NOT one of the "Triratna" (Three Jewels) of Jainism?

q: बौद्ध धर्म के पवित्र ग्रंथ "त्रिपिटक" (सुत्त पिटक, विनय पिटक, अभिधम्म पिटक) मूलतः किस भाषा में रचे गए थे?
e: The Tripitaka was composed in Pali. Sutta Pitaka (compiled by Ananda): Buddha's sermons; Vinaya Pitaka (compiled by Upali): monastic rules; Abhidhamma Pitaka (compiled at 3rd Council, Moggaliputta Tissa): philosophical analysis. Exam Boosters: (1) Early Jain Agama texts (12 Angas) were composed in Ardhamagadhi Prakrit.
qe: The Buddhist sacred canon "Tripitaka" (Sutta Pitaka, Vinaya Pitaka, Abhidhamma Pitaka) was originally composed in which language?

q: भारत में भागवत धर्म (वैष्णव धर्म) का प्राचीनतम अभिलेखीय साक्ष्य "बेसनगर (विदिशा) गरुड़ स्तंभ लेख" किस यूनानी राजदूत द्वारा स्थापित किया गया था?
e: Heliodorus (Greek ambassador of King Antialcidas of Taxila to the Shunga court of Bhagabhadra, c. 113 BCE) erected the Garuda Pillar at Besnagar (Vidisha, MP), calling himself a "Paramabhagavata" (devotee of Vasudeva Krishna).
qe: The Besnagar (Vidisha) Garuda Pillar Inscription, the earliest epigraphic evidence of Bhagavatism (Vaishnavism) in India, was erected by which Greek ambassador?

q:
सूची-I (बौद्ध संगीति) को सूची-II (शासक एवं स्थान) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. प्रथम संगीति — (a) कालाशोक, वैशाली
2. द्वितीय संगीति — (b) अजातशत्रु, राजगृह
3. तृतीय संगीति — (c) कनिष्क, कुंडलवन (कश्मीर)
4. चतुर्थ संगीति — (d) अशोक, पाटलिपुत्र
e: 1st Council (483 BCE): Ajatashatru, Rajagriha, President Mahakassapa (1-b); 2nd Council (383 BCE): Kalashoka, Vaishali, President Sabakami (2-a); 3rd Council (250 BCE): Ashoka, Pataliputra, President Moggaliputta Tissa (3-d); 4th Council (1st cent. CE): Kanishka, Kundalvana, President Vasumitra & Vice-President Ashvaghosha (4-c).
qe:
Match List-I (Buddhist Council) with List-II (Patron King & Venue):
1. First Council (प्रथम संगीति) — (a) Kalashoka, Vaishali
2. Second Council (द्वितीय संगीति) — (b) Ajatashatru, Rajagriha
3. Third Council (तृतीय संगीति) — (c) Kanishka, Kundalvana (Kashmir)
4. Fourth Council (चतुर्थ संगीति) — (d) Ashoka, Pataliputra

q: किस बौद्ध संगीति के दौरान बौद्ध धर्म औपचारिक रूप से "हीनयान" और "महायान" नामक दो प्रमुख संप्रदायों में विभाजित हो गया?
e: At the Fourth Buddhist Council (Kundalvana, Kashmir, under Kanishka), Buddhism formally divided into Hinayana (Buddha as a great teacher, Pali canon, Arhat ideal) and Mahayana (Buddha as divine, idol worship, Sanskrit texts, Bodhisattva ideal). Exam Boosters: (1) Earlier, at the 2nd Council (Vaishali), the Sangha split into Sthaviravadins and Mahasanghikas.
qe: During which Buddhist Council did Buddhism formally split into the two major sects of "Hinayana" (Theravada) and "Mahayana"?

q: "स्याद्वाद" (सापेक्षतावाद) तथा "अनेकांतवाद" के प्रसिद्ध दार्शनिक सिद्धांत किस भारतीय धार्मिक परंपरा से संबंधित हैं?
e: Syadvada (Saptabhanginaya — sevenfold conditional judgment) and Anekantavada are cornerstone epistemological doctrines of Jainism, emphasizing that ultimate truth has multiple facets. Exam Boosters: (1) Buddhism's core doctrine is Pratityasamutpada (प्रतीत्यसमुत्पाद — Dependent Origination) and Kshanikavada. (2) Ajivika sect (founded by Makkhali Gosala) preached Niyativada (fatalism/destiny).
qe: The Jain philosophical doctrines of "Syadvada" (स्याद्वाद — theory of conditional predication) and "Anekantavada" (अनेकांतवाद — theory of manifold aspects of truth) belong to which tradition?

q: प्रथम जैन संगीति (लगभग 300 ई.पू.) कहाँ और किसकी अध्यक्षता में आयोजित हुई थी, जिसमें 12 अंगों का संकलन हुआ तथा श्वेतांबर–दिगंबर विभाजन प्रारंभ हुआ?
e: The 1st Jain Council was held at Pataliputra (c. 300 BCE, during Chandragupta Maurya's reign) under Sthulabhadra (leader of white-clad Svetambaras), while Bhadrabahu led the sky-clad Digambaras to Shravanabelagola (Karnataka). Exam Boosters: (1) The 2nd Jain Council was held at Vallabhi (Gujarat, 512 CE) under Devardhi Kshamashramana, where Jain texts were finally written down.
qe: Where and under whose presidency was the First Jain Council held (c. 300 BCE), during which the 12 Angas were compiled and the Svetambara–Digambara schism began?

q: आनंद के आग्रह पर वैशाली में बौद्ध संघ (भिक्षुणी संघ) में प्रवेश पाने वाली प्रथम महिला कौन थीं?
e: Buddha's foster mother (maternal aunt) Mahaprajapati Gautami became the first Bhikkhuni (nun) in the Buddhist Sangha at Vaishali. Exam Boosters: (1) Sujata offered milk-rice (kheer) to Buddha at Uruvela before Enlightenment. (2) Amrapali (royal courtesan of Vaishali) gifted her mango grove to the Sangha.
qe: Who was the first woman to be admitted into the Buddhist Sangha (Bhikkhuni order) at Vaishali on Ananda's persuasion?

q: शैव धर्म में सबसे प्राचीन शैव संप्रदाय "पाशुपत संप्रदाय" का संस्थापक किसे माना जाता है, जिनका जन्म कायावरोहण (गुजरात) में हुआ था?
e: Lakulisha (c. 2nd century CE, considered the 28th incarnation of Shiva) founded the Pashupata sect. Exam Boosters: (1) Basavanna (12th century, Karnataka) founded the Lingayat / Virashaiva movement. (2) In South India, 63 Shaiva saints were called Nayanars and 12 Vaishnava saints were called Alvars.
qe: In Shaivism, who is regarded as the founder of the oldest Shaiva sect, the "Pashupata" (पाशुपत) sect, born at Kayavarohana (Gujarat)?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा गौतम बुद्ध द्वारा प्रतिपादित "चार आर्य सत्य" (Four Noble Truths) में सम्मिलित नहीं है?
e: Buddhism rejects the concept of an eternal unchanging soul (preaching Anatmavada / अनात्मवाद). The 4th Noble Truth is Dukkha Nirodha Gamini Pratipada—the Noble Eightfold Path (अष्टांगिक मार्ग / मध्यम मार्ग) leads to the cessation of suffering.
qe: Which of the following is NOT one of the Four Noble Truths (चार आर्य सत्य) taught by Gautama Buddha?
oe: Dukkha — The world is full of suffering
Dukkha Samudaya — Desire/craving is the cause of suffering
Dukkha Nirodha — Suffering can be ended by eliminating desire
Atma-Shashvatavada — Existence of an eternal, unchanging soul

q:
सूची-I (बुद्ध के जीवन की घटना) को सूची-II (बौद्ध प्रतीक) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. जन्म — (a) अश्व
2. महाभिनिष्क्रमण — (b) कमल एवं साँड़
3. धर्मचक्रप्रवर्तन — (c) स्तूप
4. महापरिनिर्वाण — (d) चक्र
e: Birth: Lotus & Bull (1-b); Mahabhinishkramana (leaving home at age 29): Horse Kanthaka (2-a); First Sermon at Sarnath: Wheel (3-d); Mahaparinirvana at Kushinagar (age 80, 483 BCE): Stupa (4-c). Exam Boosters: (1) Enlightenment (Nirvana) symbol: Bodhi Tree. (2) Conception (Garbha) symbol: White Elephant.
qe:
Match List-I (Event in Buddha's Life) with List-II (Traditional Buddhist Symbol):
1. Birth (जन्म) — (a) Horse (अश्व)
2. Great Renunciation / Mahabhinishkramana (महाभिनिष्क्रमण) — (b) Lotus & Bull (कमल एवं साँड़)
3. First Sermon / Dhammachakkappavattana (धर्मचक्रप्रवर्तन) — (c) Stupa (स्तूप)
4. Death / Mahaparinirvana (महापरिनिर्वाण) — (d) Wheel / Dharmachakra (चक्र)

q: प्रारंभिक भागवत धर्म (पांचरात्र / चतुर्व्यूह सिद्धांत) में वृष्णि वीरों (संकर्षण, प्रद्युम्न, अनिरुद्ध) के साथ प्रमुख देवता के रूप में किसकी उपासना की जाती है?
e: The Chaturvyuha doctrine of Bhagavatism centres on Vasudeva Krishna (first mentioned as Devakiputra Krishna in Chandogya Upanishad) along with Sankarshana (Balarama), Pradyumna, and Aniruddha. Exam Boosters: (1) The Mora Well Inscription (Mathura) mentions the five Vrishni heroes (Panchavira, including Samba).
qe: In early Bhagavatism (Pancharatra / Chaturvyuha doctrine), who among the following is worshipped as the chief deity along with his Vrishni heroes (Sankarshana, Pradyumna, Aniruddha)?

q: वे महान महायान बौद्ध दार्शनिक कौन थे जिन्होंने अपने प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ "मूलमध्यमककारिका" में "शून्यवाद" (माध्यमिक दर्शन) का प्रतिपादन किया?
e: Acharya Nagarjuna (c. 2nd century CE, often called the "Einstein of India") founded the Madhyamika (Shunyavada) school of Mahayana Buddhism. Exam Boosters: (1) Asanga and Vasubandhu founded the Yogachara (Vijnanavada / विज्ञानवाद) school of Mahayana. (2) Buddhaghosha authored "Visuddhimagga" (Theravada).
qe: Who was the great Mahayana Buddhist philosopher who propounded the doctrine of "Shunyavada" (Madhyamika philosophy — शून्यवाद) in his famous treatise "Mulamadhyamakakarika"?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा जैन धर्म के "श्वेतांबर" और "दिगंबर" संप्रदायों के बीच के अंतर का सही वर्णन करता है?
o: दिगंबर मानते हैं कि स्त्रियाँ सीधे मोक्ष प्राप्त कर सकती हैं, श्वेतांबर नहीं
श्वेतांबर मल्लिनाथ को स्त्री मानते हैं व स्त्री-मोक्ष स्वीकारते हैं, जबकि दिगंबर उन्हें पुरुष मानते हैं
दिगंबर वल्लभी में संकलित 12 अंगों को मानते हैं, श्वेतांबर नहीं
श्वेतांबर महावीर को अविवाहित मानते हैं, दिगंबर विवाहित
e: Svetambaras hold that the 19th Tirthankara Mallinatha was a woman, women can achieve liberation, Mahavira was married to Yashoda, and they accept the Vallabhi Agamas. Digambaras reject all four positions. (अतः केवल विकल्प B सही है।)
qe: Which of the following correctly describes the distinction between the "Svetambara" and "Digambara" sects of Jainism?
oe: Digambaras believe women can attain Moksha directly in their female body, while Svetambaras deny it
Svetambaras believe Mallinatha (19th Tirthankara) was a woman and women can attain Moksha, whereas Digambaras hold Mallinatha was a man
Digambaras accept all 12 Angas compiled at Vallabhi, while Svetambaras reject them
Svetambaras believe Mahavira never married, whereas Digambaras believe he married Yashoda

q: नाथमुनि द्वारा संकलित किस प्रारंभिक तमिल भक्ति ग्रंथ में 12 वैष्णव आलवार संतों के भक्ति पद संकलित हैं और जिसे "तमिल वेद" कहा जाता है?
e: The Nalayira Divya Prabandham ("Four Thousand Sacred Hymns", compiled by Nathamuni) preserves the hymns of the 12 Alvars (including the only female Alvar saint, Andal). Exam Boosters: (1) Tevaram and Tirumurai (compiled by Nambi Andar Nambi) are the Shaiva Nayanar canons. (2) Core features of Bhakti: personal devotion (Prapatti), rejection of caste barriers, use of vernacular languages, and guru-shishya tradition.
qe: Which early Tamil Bhakti anthology, compiled by Nathamuni, contains the devotional hymns of the 12 Vaishnava Alvar saints and is revered as the "Tamil Veda"?

q:
बौद्ध संघ और उसकी शब्दावली के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: "उपसंपदा" बौद्ध भिक्षु की पूर्ण दीक्षा संस्कार थी, जबकि "प्रवारणा" वर्षावास के अंत में आयोजित अपराध-स्वीकारोक्ति समारोह था।
कथन II: ऋणी, दास और सेवारत सैनिक बिना किसी अनुमति के बौद्ध संघ में स्वतंत्र रूप से प्रवेश कर सकते थे।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो I और न ही II
e: Statement I is correct ("Pabbajja" was initial entry, "Upasampada" full ordination, "Uposatha" fortnightly gathering, "Pavarana" post-monsoon confession). Statement II is incorrect because debtors, slaves, soldiers in service, and criminals were strictly barred from entering the Sangha without prior clearance from creditors/masters/kings.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Buddhist Sangha and its terminology:
Statement I: "Upasampada" referred to the final ordination ceremony of a Buddhist monk, whereas "Pavarana" was a confession ceremony held at the end of the rainy season retreat (Vassa).
Statement II: Debtors, slaves, and soldiers in active royal service were freely admitted into the Buddhist Sangha without permission.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
